dct_description_sm: The Pedestrian Network Polygon contains the location of the developed areas around the City of Peterborough where people can travel on foot, on tiny wheels and/or wheelchairs. This layer displays Bicycle & Footpaths, Sidewalks, Sidewalk Walkways and Trails.
